neighbours.label: Weak guess: a noun for a rich or named collection before 'of' (a roster of, a wealth of, a lineup of); other measure nouns stay quiet
fire: Next month she will join a roster of celebrated cellists.
The site offers a wealth of practical advice for parents.
The promoter announced a lineup of rising comedians.
His archive holds a treasure of unpublished letters.
The studio has built a stable of young animators.
This guide contains a trove of forgotten recipes.
The club has assembled a roster of former champions.
Readers will find a wealth of detail on medieval trade.
quiet: Next month she will buy a sheet of expensive paper.
The site offers a glass of cold water for parents.
The promoter announced a change of venue downtown.
His archive holds a photo of his late mother.
The studio has built a wall of pale bricks.
This guide contains a map of the old harbour.
The club has opened a branch of its bank.
Readers will find a list of errors on the last page.
